findings.description: CON-SUP-127 and CON-SUP-147 require timing-limit tests to use margins of at least 200 µs on either side of a limit. The set records test methods for SYS-SUP-002, SYS-SUP-003, SYS-SUP-056 and SYS-SUP-093 but does not record that verification constraint.
findings.requested_change: Record the required timing-test margins in the verification intent for the affected requirements.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-054 says every system requirement can be verified on the simulator or by host unit tests, while SYS-SUP-072 requires inspection of board pull-down resistors and SYS-SUP-086 specifies analysis of the board output-stage timing. Those verification approaches are not established as simulator or host unit tests.
findings.requested_change: Align the simulator verification claim with the specified verification methods and the scope supported by CON-SUP-005 and STK-SUP-015.
